name: Thomas Wong
office: City of Monterey Park, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Thomas Wong represents District 1 on the Monterey Park City Council. Elected in 2022, he has been mayor and mayor pro tem. After the 2023 mass shooting, he worked with nonprofits helping people seek support. He was previously board president of the San Gabriel Valley Municipal Water District, supporting Monterey Park infrastructure investments.

sentences.text: Thomas Wong represents District 1 on the Monterey Park City Council.
Elected in 2022, he has been mayor and mayor pro tem.
After the 2023 mass shooting, he worked with nonprofits helping people seek support.
He was previously board president of the San Gabriel Valley Municipal Water District, supporting Monterey Park infrastructure investments.

items.text: He supported a 2026 ballot measure banning data centers citywide. In 2026, he sought to adjust Monterey Park Transit fees due to demand. He proposed researching rules to make government property free from U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. As an environmental commissioner, he backed a climate action plan and environmentally preferred purchasing policy. He recused himself from a 2026 transit vote because he lives near the project.
